points.description: States FALSE (the exec system call can be used in the parent after fork without waiting for the child to terminate).
Justification: parent and child are independent processes, so the parent can carry on and do any operation, including exec, regardless of the child.
points.partial_credit: Half credit if justification is vague, e.g. says only that they run separately or that the parent can still run, without mentioning exec or independence.

rubric.notes: Full marks for FALSE plus the idea that parent and child are independent so the parent can exec any time, in any wording. Give 0 if the answer is TRUE or if no justification is given, since the question says no justification means no marks. Give 1 if FALSE is stated with a vague or partly right reason.
